I’m happy to share a quick overview! Shipping timelines depend largely on where your order ships from, how far away the destination is, and whether you’re choosing standard versus expedited options. 7–10 business days (international) | | **Expedited/Express** | 1–3 business days (domestic)
3–7 business days (intl.) | | **Same‑Day / Next‑Day** | Available only within certain metropolitan areas | \*These estimates assume normal processing—no holidays, weather delays, or customs holds. If you’d like a more precise ETA for a particular shipment, let me know the origin ZIP/postal code, destination country/city, and preferred delivery speed. I’ll pull up the exact window for you right here.
